KAVINDRA E M 
 Phone : 8610152642 | Email : kavindra.em2024aiml@sece.ac.in | GitHub | LinkedIn 
 
 
EDUCATION 
 
COLLEGE EDUCATION – Sri Eshwar College of Engineering || 8.9 (IIIrd- sem) 2024-2028 
SCHOOLING – Orison Academy (CBSE) || 93.8% 2023-2024 
SCHOOLING – Vivek Vidya Mandir (CBSE) || 94.8% 
INTERNSHIP 
 2021-2022 
 
 Completed a 16-day MERN Stack internship at Educentro, Trichy, where I gained hands-on experience in full-stack web development 
using MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js. Worked on building reusable UI components, creating REST APIs, managing database 
operations, and integrating frontend with backend. Additionally, I practiced version control using Git/GitHub and improved my debugging, 
testing, and deployment skills through real-time project tasks. 
PROJECTS 
PRISM (Prison Risk and Incident Surveillance Monitor): 
Developed an AI-powered harassment detection system using Raspberry Pi with integrated camera hardware, enabling real-time video 
analysis on edge devices. Designed and optimized machine learning models for accurate detection and automated alerting. Delivered a 
complete hardware–AI prototype, combining embedded systems with deep learning for practical safety applications. 2025 
BIO-IMMUNE KIDNEY MONITOR (Bioimpedance & ISF Sensing): 
Developed a wearable kidney-health monitor integrating bioimpedance spectroscopy and microneedle ISF sensing for fluid-balance and 
biomarker assessment. Designed multi-frequency impedance hardware and electrochemical creatinine/urea sensors, with real-time signal 
processing and a mobile dashboard to deliver early alerts for renal dysfunction. 2025 
FINGUARD AI (Intelligent Financial Assistance & Investment Platform): 
Built an AI-powered personal finance management system integrating machine learning, data science, and full-stack development for 
real-time behavioral analytics and investment recommendations. Designed and trained ML models including Random Forest for financial 
personality detection, Logistic Regression for stress prediction, Prophet/LSTM for expense forecasting, and Markowitz Mean-Variance 
optimization for portfolio allocation. Delivered a complete React + Spring Boot + Python FastAPI platform with anomaly detection, Monte 
Carlo retirement simulation, and an interactive analytics dashboard for actionable financial intelligence 2026 
TransitOps - Full-Stack Fleet & Logistics Management Platform 
Built a fleet and logistics platform (React 18, Node.js/Express, SQLite) with JWT/bcrypt authentication, role-based access control across 
four operational roles, and automated account-lockout security. Delivered a real-time operations dashboard (Recharts, React Leaflet) 
tracking 8 live fleet metrics and GPS telemetry, plus an automated fuel-purchase auditing system flagging anomalies indicative of fraud or 
odometer discrepancies. 2026
